label: fs-w144-width1152-optimizer-group-costs-r1
purpose: Measure actual width1152 optimizer groups after the pack32 MLP width gate. Derive inventory from the exact source140 native configuration, override only width, then measure each full group and a representative per-owner Muon count in separate processes. Native dispatch/stack/copy/update costs include five warmups then five blocks of ten updates. Synthetic fixed gradients, no model training/quality claim. This prepares measured costs only; planner unchanged and exact ownership/state/all-gather gate remains mandatory. Dispatch after caller analysis and raw transfers on this host complete. Input log is the byte-verified committed source144 mirror of the trn22 capture, so the trn21 job does not assume a cross-host source140 path exists.
command:
import json,subprocess,sys,pathlib,math,hashlib
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave144/research/run-logs/fs-w140-native-pack32-micro-device-profile-r2.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='8efb3566ac976a7aff6b958186aca004a5f03be661c12eaae0c578bc877e3235'
post=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave143/research/run-logs/fs-w143-native-mlp-widths1024-1152-integration-r1.postflight.json').read_text())
assert post['host_clean'] and post['command_returncode']==0
base=[sys.executable,'-u','research/scratch/optimizer_group_cost_probe.py','--config-log','/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave144/research/run-logs/fs-w140-native-pack32-micro-device-profile-r2.log','--width','1152']
inventory=subprocess.run(base+['--inventory-only'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
print(inventory.stdout,flush=True)
records=[json.loads(line.split(' ',1)[1]) for line in inventory.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('OPTIMIZER_ACTUAL_INVENTORY ')]
assert len(records)==1
cases=[]
for group in records[0]['groups']:
 if not group['count']:continue
 counts=[group['count']]
 if group['kind']=='muon':counts.append(min(group['count'],max(2,math.ceil(group['count']/4))))
 for count in sorted(set(counts)):
  cases.append(dict(group_index=group['index'],kind=group['kind'],count=count))
print('COST_CASES '+json.dumps(cases),flush=True)
assert 4<=len(cases)<=18
for case in cases:
 print('COST_CASE_START '+json.dumps(case),flush=True)
 subprocess.run(base+['--group-index',str(case['group_index']),'--count',str(case['count'])],check=True)
print('COST_GRID_COMPLETE '+json.dumps(dict(width=1152,cases=len(cases),ownership_plan_unchanged=True,exact_ownership_gate_pending=True)),flush=True)
